title: BW Script
features:
⚔️ Combat Features
• Anti Annoy (stops abilities dragging your camera around)
• Auto Fightback (struggles for you when someone grabs you)
• Auto Skill Check (passes skill checks for you)
• Instant Craft (places the sigil the moment it appears, no drawing needed)
• Speed Boost (move faster and jump higher)
• Open Voodoo Shop (opens the shop from anywhere)

🤖 Aim Assister
• Hitbox Extender (picks targets further from your cursor, so you don't have to aim precisely)
• Range Extender (increases how far your abilities can reach) with a Range Multiplier slider

⚡ BW Outspammer
• Outspammer (spams your equipped ability on the target nearest your cursor) faster than an autoclicker
• Exclude Targets & Exclude Friends (never targets the players you pick or your friends)

🔔 Notifications
• White Oak Notifier (tells you when the White Oak Tree grows back)
• Death Notifier (tells you when a character stops being played)

👁️ ESP
• Player ESP (name tags showing character, species, health and magic) with keybind
• Show Health / Show Status (adds an IMMORTAL / TOTEM / IMMUNE line under the species)
• Totem ESP (outlines ritual totems through walls)
• Bone ESP (outlines bone piles through walls)

🔄 Auto Spawn
• Auto Spawn (keeps you spawned as your chosen character) with keybind
• Character & Outfit selectors (outfit is equipped as soon as you pick it)
• Spawn (spawns you as the chosen character once)

⚙️ Essentials & Settings
• Infinite Yield Admin (one-click IY)
• Good Ping Server / Rejoin Server
• FPS Booster
• Show Watermark
• RGB Accent

💾 Configuration & Customization
• Configs: save, load and auto-load your profiles
• Themes: full UI colour styling
